recipe.title: Li4Mn2O, O2 site, the paper's full active space
recipe.why: The 18 orbitals of 2405.11015 and 2506.15784: Mn 3d, Li 2s, O 2p and O 1s. AVAS here counts 24 electrons where the paper, after tuning its threshold, has 22. With about 3.4 x 10^8 determinants it is far beyond exact classical methods, so no reference: a target for fault tolerant hardware.
